hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: To maximize the concatenated binary value, sort segments using a custom pairwise comparison.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: For two binary segments a and b, place a before b if a + b > b + a in lexicographical binary comparison.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Concatenate the sorted segments and compute their value modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Custom sort evaluates string concatenations in O(n log n * l) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all n! permutations is factorial in complexity.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Applies comparator a + b > b + a to guarantee globally optimal concatenation.
